t: The Hive Mini V4 wireless heating smart thermostat delivers proactive temperature control for combi boilers with a compact, simple design ideal for homes seeking straightforward heating management. This battery-powered device activates heating only when needed, reducing energy consumption and boiler wear whilst maintaining comfort. The touchscreen thermostat integrates with Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit and Google Home, plus iOS and Android apps for remote management from anywhere. Features include OpenTherm compatibility for enhanced boiler efficiency, frost protection for pipes, heating boost up to 6 hours, and flexible scheduling with up to 6 daily time slots, all managed by the supplied smart hub.
